title: Show HN: Rocksky – Music scrobbling and discovery on the AT Protocol
summary: Rocksky is a music scrobbling and discovery application built on the AT Protocol (Bluesky's decentralized protocol). It allows users to track their music listening history and discover new music while owning their data on a decentralized platform rather than relying on centralized services like Last.fm.
problem_solved: Provides decentralized music scrobbling, giving users ownership and control over their listening data instead of being locked into centralized platforms.
why_valuable: Offers an alternative to Last.fm with decentralized architecture, allowing users to retain ownership of their music listening history and integrate with the emerging AT Protocol ecosystem.
